## Hey, I'm Zyres 👋

C++ developer from Zürich, writing open source since 2014. I like big, old codebases and making them fast, clean and modern again:
network protocols, game server logic, databases, build systems and the tools around them.

- 🛠️ Daily driver: modern C++ (20/23), CMake, MySQL, Python for tooling
- 🔍 Favourite kind of work: reverse engineering binary protocols and turning them into readable code
- 🌱 Lately: Dear ImGui desktop apps and code generation tools
- 💬 Talk to me on [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/CBdgrh7) or open an issue

## Main project: AscEmu

Most of my commits go into **[AscEmu](https://github.com/AscEmu/AscEmu)**, an open source World of Warcraft server emulator that continues the code line of Ascent and ArcEmu.
One codebase serves 13 client builds:

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zyres/Zyres/output/builds-dark.svg">
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)" srcset="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zyres/Zyres/output/builds-light.svg">
  <img alt="Classic 1.12.1 to Midnight 12.1.5 and Forever" src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zyres/Zyres/output/builds-dark.svg" width="100%">
</picture>

| | Project | What it is |
|:-:|:--|:--|
| ⚔️ | **[AscEmu/AscEmu](https://github.com/AscEmu/AscEmu)** | The server: logon, world, scripts and tools for all supported versions |
| 🗃️ | **[AscEmu/OneDB](https://github.com/AscEmu/OneDB)** | One world database, version specific rows selected by client build |
| 📖 | **[AscEmu/Wiki](https://github.com/AscEmu/Wiki)** | Setup guides, coding standards and the full database documentation |
| 🏛️ | **[Zyres/AscentHistory](https://github.com/Zyres/AscentHistory)** | The last known Ascent source, kept for history |
